This issuer exhibits strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 41% ($1,307M on $3,198M in revenue) and a solid asset base of $58,573M. However, its capital structure is highly leveraged (total liabilities of $43,578M against equity of $12,807M), liquid liquidity is constrained with a current ratio of 0.53 ($3,244M in current assets vs $6,106M in current liabilities), and it has a massive accumulated deficit (retained earnings of -$12,237M). This combination of highly profitable business operations but a weak, highly leveraged balance sheet and short-term liquidity pressure is characteristic of a sub-investment grade borrower with moderate credit risk.

DECISION: BB
